Generated seccomp filter rules for XDP tile syscalls and argument checks.

# Purpose
This header defines a generated seccomp BPF policy for the `fd_xdp_tile` component. It sets the target architecture with `ARCH_NR` and builds a fixed `sock_filter` program with `45` instructions that restricts the process to a small set of system calls. The policy allows `write`, `fsync`, `sendto`, `recvmsg`, and `getsockopt` only when the file descriptor and argument values match the expected XDP socket and log file values, and it blocks all other calls with `SECCOMP_RET_KILL_PROCESS`. The [`populate_sock_filter_policy_fd_xdp_tile`](<#populate_sock_filter_policy_fd_xdp_tile>) function copies the prepared filter into the caller buffer, so the codebase can install the same syscall rules at runtime without manual edits to the generated file.
